fichas.title: Retail Shop Windows
fichas.summary: Shop windows present merchandise and invite customers to purchase. Their design depends on the goods and should complement the entrance layout, form, and size. The page distinguishes display-area windows, which separate merchandise from the sales area, from windows that provide a view into the shop; both have illustrated variants.
uses: Attract customer interest and invite purchases
Separate displayed goods from the sales area
Provide a view into the sales area
furniture_equipment: Stepped shop-window display with glazed screen behind
Mobile shop-window display unit with screen behind
